summary: Wilkinson County tower on the Georgia list at 512 ft (GFC 617); OpenStreetMap maps it as a lattice observation tower. No build, staffing or status source found.

evidence.supports: listed in Wilkinson County at 32.82959, -83.23932, 512 ft, codes BLL-41093 and gfc-617
GFC supplied coordinates for 118 towers under the BLL code
older GFC list described 203 towers under the gfc code
evidence.quote: an older GFC list described the locations of 203 towers (gfc-nnn)

evidence.supports: OpenStreetMap location almost the same as the list point

notes_for_editor: Only a state list entry and an OpenStreetMap node. Two WebSearch queries (Wilkinson County history; Irwinton fire tower) found no fire tower record there. The list gives 512 ft (156 m); the OSM ele tag gives 155 m; the story uses the list figure only. The list header gives no unit; feet is read from the list's own values (Brasstown Lookout Tower at 4735 only fits feet). A map point does not show that the tower still stands; status and access are left unknown. The list's notes explain the codes: BLL marks coordinates GFC supplied, gfc marks the older GFC list; the brief's GFC US 617 is the gfc code. Fact-check 2026-10-21: the list's notes do not say the 203 towers are additional to the 118, so the story no longer says '203 more'. The story also no longer says no source describes the site, because the OpenStreetMap node does map a tower there; it now says no source gives its condition or public access.
